name: DESCRIPTION
value: Pettenderly is an online AI pet portrait studio for cat and dog owners. Upload one to five photos of the same pet, choose a watercolor, royal or studio style, and download a digital portrait. The Starter Pack costs $4.99 for 12 non-expiring credits. Each successful image uses one credit. Failed generations do not consume credits. Beta features include portraits together and photo cleanup. Results may vary; physical prints are not included.

name: META_KEYWORDS
value: AI pet portraits, cat portraits, dog portraits

name: META_DESCRIPTION
value: Create downloadable AI pet portraits from cat or dog photos with Pettenderly.
